verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents its own ways to move workload data off rented instances: a CLI flow that includes copying data, SSH file transfer, and direct Jupyter downloads to your local machine. Instance data can therefore be pulled out over standard protocols, but there is no documented account-wide export or exit path. missing for 10: a documented full account/data export (billing, instance history, templates, volumes metadata), explicit open-format export guarantees, an offboarding/account-deletion path, and independent corroboration of leaving cleanly.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
